You can purchase NAC (N-acetyl cysteine) supplements both online and in-store at major retailers, pharmacies, and specialty health shops. While it was once under regulatory review by the FDA, it remains widely available as an over-the-counter (OTC) supplement.

Where to Buy NAC

  • Major Retailers: You can find NAC at Walmart, Target, and Amazon. These stores often carry both national brands like NOW Foods and their own private labels like Spring Valley.
  • Pharmacies: Walgreens and CVS typically stock NAC in their vitamin aisles, often filed under "Detox," "Liver Support," or "Immune Health."
  • Health & Specialty Stores: Retailers like The Vitamin Shoppe, iHerb, and Vitacost offer a wider variety of brands and dosages.
  • Direct from Brands: Many reputable supplement companies like Pure Encapsulations, Thorne, and Life Extension sell directly through their own websites.

Recommended NAC Supplements

When shopping, look for products that are third-party tested (such as NSF or USP certified) to ensure purity, as supplements are not regulated as strictly as prescription drugs.

The NOW 600 mg NAC is a highly popular and budget-friendly option. It includes selenium and molybdenum, which are trace minerals that assist the body's natural antioxidant processes. Because NAC is a sulfur-containing amino acid, users often note a strong scent, but this is a normal characteristic of the ingredient.

For those looking for a higher dosage, the Now Foods NAC 1000 mg provides a more potent serving size. It is widely recognized for its role in replenishing glutathione, the body's "master antioxidant," which supports liver health and immune function.

If you have a sensitive stomach or prefer a brand used frequently by healthcare practitioners, Pure Encapsulations NAC 600 mg is a high-quality choice. It is formulated to be free from common allergens, artificial additives, and GMOs, making it a "cleaner" option for those with dietary restrictions.

Summary of Top Options

  • Best Value: Nutricost N-Acetyl L-Cysteine NAC Capsules offers a high capsule count for a lower price.
  • Best for Sensitivities: Pure Encapsulations NAC 600 mg focuses on hypoallergenic ingredients.
  • Most Popular: NOW 600 mg NAC has thousands of positive reviews highlighting its effectiveness for respiratory support.

Important Note: NAC is also available as a prescription medication (often inhaled or via IV) for specific medical uses like acetaminophen overdose or thinning mucus in lung disease. Always consult with a healthcare professional before starting NAC, especially if you have asthma or are taking other medications.
